name: Kesho College
description: Kesho College — an editorial theme for a hairdressing and beauty college. A near-black ground with one light lilac accent (#D9B6CF), three flush 2:3 high-key portrait panels drifting slowly left across the first screen under a giant two-line Cormorant Garamond word that the bottom edge cuts off, a centred intake statement, a wide photograph with an oversized caption overlapping its edge, a day-by-hour schedule in hairline rows, square course tiles with the title inside, instructors, a full-width tuition table and an open-morning band. Cormorant Garamond for headings, Karla for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; entrance animations respect reduced motion.

fonts.role: display: wordmark, the giant hero word, headings, times, course titles (variable 300-700, regular and italic, Latin subset)
text: body, labels, navigation, buttons (variable 200-800, Latin subset)
